source_context.caption_hook: Linkedin content creation tools are getting SCARY good at helping you write content (and I truly think some of them are really impressive!)
caption_argument_segments: Linkedin content creation tools are getting SCARY good at helping you write content (and I truly think some of them are really impressive!)
And once you have great content going out consistently, the next question becomes: WHY do some posts drive more pipeline than others?
- Which posts actually influenced leads - Which topics consistently drive demo calls - Which content brought in pipeline vs just impressions
*this is the layer that turns content into a feedback loop (see image below)

Because the writing part is solved (or at least way easier than it used to be), but the post-publish side is still mostly guesswork...you write, you post, you see likes and comments, and then you assume what worked base…
And engagement is not the same as business impact
